## Summary

Slam Dunk Bets recommended WAGERS wagers on LEAGUE first-event props in MONTH YEAR. They returned +NET net units on STAKED units staked, a return on investment (ROI) of ROI%. The season to date stands at +STD_NET units (STD_ROI%) on STD_WAGERS wagers.

## How we counted

Wager sizes are standardized so that the average recommended wager is about one unit. Net units are winnings minus losses, ROI is net units divided by units staked, and voided wagers are excluded. These are tracked results, not a guarantee; past results do not predict future results.
